goal: Implement explicit independent interactive Code Agent Review and Findings Verification sessions via SupervisedSessionPort (imm-session create/await/stop), dedicated out-of-tree JSON output files with sha256 receipt and Verification double-read plus D6 tree guard, Lane ReviewProfile propagation (transport, model, effort), and non-polling recovery wording per docs/specs/explicit-port-review-session.spec.md (BR-REQ-1, BR-REQ-2, BR-DEC-2, BR-DEC-3, BR-OUT-1, BR-SCN-1).

acceptance.assertion: Per docs/specs/explicit-port-review-session.spec.md AC1 and BR-SCN-1, Lane ReviewProfile (transport, host, model, effort, verifier model) propagates across layered_config.ts, host-core/runtime.ts, coordinator.ts, and cli_review.ts; when herdr transport is active, prepareReview and prepareVerification emit explicit imm-session create and imm-session await interactive Code Agent launch instructions with zero imports from runtime/session/ inside runtime/assurance/, Kernel, or Host adapters (BR-OUT-1), and pending recovery messages in cli_review.ts, review_mediation.ts, and coordinator.ts omit repeat submit_review/submit_verification polling instructions (BR-REQ-1, F1).

Per docs/specs/explicit-port-review-session.spec.md AC2 and BR-SCN-1, prepareReview and prepareVerification allocate dedicated out-of-tree temp JSON output_path targets (with Claude Write(<output_path>) allowlist and D6 Git tree guard across hosts), inspectReview and inspectVerification reject terminal scrollback and validate strict JSON from output_path with file-byte sha256 receipt (preserving Verification double-read consistency), and consumed PASS/REVISE/verification_ready/awaiting_user receipts instruct imm-session stop cleanup while abnormal exits, contract mismatches, dirty trees, or invalid JSON retain the session tab without cleanup (BR-REQ-2, BR-DEC-2, BR-DEC-3).

Per docs/specs/explicit-port-review-session.spec.md AC3, runtime/prompts/code-review.md, runtime/prompts/review-verifier.md, role_prompt_bridge.ts, skills/authority-review/SKILL.md, agents/immune-brain-review-verifier.md, dist/role-prompts/* mirrors, and dist/drive.md agree on writing strict JSON verdicts/verifications to the dedicated out-of-tree output_path and executing the explicit imm-session create -> await -> submit -> stop lifecycle without drift.
